name: subject_threshold_council_balanced_k180
description: Main release: subject-threshold cells where trajectory, measurement, or raw-semantic interpreters mostly agree.
public_question: If this beats the 0.561288 base, S hidden generation needs subject thresholds plus independent state-interpreter agreement.

name: subject_threshold_council_wide_k320
description: Wide release: same council direction, larger support. This asks whether the S equation is broad rather than sparse.
public_question: If wide wins over balanced, remaining S signal is a broad subject-threshold field, not a few high-confidence cells.

name: s3s4_threshold_trajectory_council_k140
description: S3/S4 focused release: latency/WASO style labels require stronger trajectory or raw-semantic agreement.
public_question: If this is best, post-conflict residual is mostly S3/S4 phase and boundary interpretation.

name: dual_negative_sparse_council_k120
description: Strict release: raw public-memory and local residual diagnostics both must hear the action as anti-harm.
public_question: If this wins while wider releases fail, the S generator is real but only audible under strict action-safety constraints.

name: opposite_sign_council_search_k180
description: Opposite-sign search: choose cells that become audible when the subject-threshold direction is inverted. This is a sensor for sign ambiguity, not an exact negative control.
public_question: If this improves, a second sign regime exists. Exact reverse controls below decide whether the main sign itself is wrong.

name: exact_reverse_of_balanced_k180
description: Exact negative control: same cells as balanced_k180, opposite logit direction.
public_question: Should be harmful if the main council direction is correct.

name: exact_reverse_of_wide_k320
description: Exact negative control: same cells as wide_k320, opposite logit direction.
public_question: Should be harmful if the main council direction is correct.

name: two_regime_assignment_union_k360
description: Union of disjoint regime-A and regime-B cells. Biggest two-regime hidden S assignment test.
public_question: Tests whether S row-targets split into two hidden sign regimes rather than one global subject-threshold polarity.

name: two_regime_assignment_top240
description: Top 240 cells across both sign regimes by council selection score.
public_question: Tests whether S row-targets split into two hidden sign regimes rather than one global subject-threshold polarity.

name: two_regime_assignment_pairbalanced_k240
